Dec 10, 2025

### Luminance Deepens U.S. Leadership Bench as Region Delivers 2.5X Revenue Growth

Luminance, the global leader in Legal-Grade™ AI for the enterprise, today announced two major additions to its U.S. leadership team as demand for its multi-agent AI platform accelerates across Fortune-scale organizations.

The hires arrive as Luminance reports a 2.5X increase in U.S. revenue over the past year, spurred by rapid adoption among enterprise teams, spanning legal, compliance, procurement, finance and more. With the U.S. now representing 44% of global revenue, Luminance is doubling down on scale, leadership, and market reach in the region.

**Industry Veteran Mario Queiroz Joins as Senior Product Advisor**

Luminance has appointed Mario Queiroz as Senior Product Advisor, based in San Francisco. A veteran product and technology executive with more than three decades of experience, Queiroz has led global teams building category-defining products at the intersection of software, devices, and AI.

He most recently served as Chief Product Officer at Abridge and, before that, as Chief Product Officer at Hinge Health, where he helped scale both companies’ AI-driven platforms. Earlier in his career, he was EVP at Palo Alto Networks and spent close to 15 years at Google in product and general management roles. During his tenure at Google, he led several of the company’s flagship consumer hardware initiatives, from Chromecast and Google Home to serving as General Manager and Vice President of Product Management for Pixel smartphones.

Queiroz holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in electrical engineering from Stanford University.

**Kim Winter Joins as VP of Marketing**

Luminance also brings on Kim Winter as Vice President of Marketing, based in New York. Winter is a seasoned marketing leader with extensive experience building marketing functions from the ground up and developing product marketing strategies for high-growth companies. She joins from Yotpo, where she spent nearly a decade and rose to **VP of Product Marketing,** shaping product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.

Winter brings deep expertise in messaging, category creation, and enterprise GTM execution, with a track record of turning complex technology into clear business value. At Luminance, she will lead global marketing efforts, strengthening the company’s enterprise presence and driving category-defining narratives as adoption accelerates globally.

_“Mario and Kim join us at a pivotal moment for Luminance. U.S. enterprises now make up almost half our business, a trajectory that continues to steepen quarter after quarter. Mario brings the product and AI rigor of someone who’s helped build some of the world’s most iconic tech platforms. Kim brings the marketing leadership and storytelling muscle needed to define this next category. Together, they’ll help us scale faster, stay closer to our customers, and strengthen our position as the enterprise standard for legal AI.”_ – Eleanor Lightbody, CEO, Luminance.

**About Luminance**

Luminance is the Contract Intelligence platform that turns the language that defines a business into the intelligence it runs on. Born out of the University of Cambridge and purpose-built by AI, legal and technology experts, Luminance understands the history and context of every contract. It acts on that intelligence, proactively surfacing risk, flagging obligations, accelerating negotiations and driving action across Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales and the wider business. It enables enterprises to learn from their contracts, while contracts learn from the enterprise, helping businesses make better decisions and move forward with confidence.
